import os,json,hashlib,pathlib,sys,time,importlib.metadata as md
E=pathlib.Path('/e/wheel-tests/inherited')
def _capture(phase):
 label=os.environ['A23_RUN_LABEL']; mode='source' if '/e/wheel-tests/src' in ':'.join(sys.path) else 'wheel';prefix='/e/wheel-tests/src/' if mode=='source' else '/e/wheel-venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/'
 loaded=[]
 for n,m in list(sys.modules.items()):
  if n=='agent_guard' or n.startswith('agent_guard.'):
   p=getattr(m,'__file__',None)
   if p:
    assert p.startswith(prefix),(n,p,prefix)
    q=pathlib.Path(p);rel=q.relative_to(prefix);original=E/'sourcecopy/src'/rel;assert q.read_bytes()==original.read_bytes();loaded.append({'module':n,'file':p,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
 d={'phase':phase,'label':label,'mode':mode,'pid':os.getpid(),'timestamp':time.time(),'python':sys.version,'sys_path':sys.path,'loaded_production':loaded,'metadata_version':md.version('agent-guard'),'direct_url':md.distribution('agent-guard').read_text('direct_url.json')};p=E/'runtime'/label/(phase+'-runtime-provenance.json');p.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2));p.chmod(0o600)
def pytest_sessionstart(session):_capture('start')
def pytest_sessionfinish(session,exitstatus):_capture('finish')
